title: AI vs ML vs Deep Learning vs GenAI

scenes.text: AI. Machine learning. Deep learning. Generative AI. [1] Everyone is using these words. But what do they actually mean? [2] Let's fix that, in under three minutes.
scenes.image: Vibrant flat illustration, friendly Indian teacher with glasses pointing at a glowing chalkboard of AI buzzwords, dark navy background, neon violet and teal accents, clean vector style

scenes.text: Let's start with the biggest one. [1] Artificial Intelligence is any machine doing something that normally needs human intelligence. [2] Recognising a face. [3] Understanding speech. [4] Making a decision.

data.definition: Machines doing things that normally need human intelligence.

scenes.text: Old school software follows rules that a programmer writes by hand. [1] If an email contains the word lottery, mark it as spam. But spammers change their words every day. [2] Machine learning flips this. Instead of writing rules, we show the machine thousands of examples, spam and not spam, [3] and it learns the rules by itself.
And you use machine learning every single day. [1] Gmail's spam filter. [2] Netflix and YouTube recommending what to watch next. [3] Your bank flagging a suspicious card payment in seconds.

data.heading: Machine Learning in your day
items: Learns what you like to watch

scenes.text: Deep learning is a kind of machine learning inspired by the human brain. [1] It uses neural networks. Layers of tiny math units, connected together. [2] Each layer spots something a little more complex. Edges. [3] Then shapes. [4] Then, a cat. More layers means more depth, and that's why it's called deep learning.
Deep learning is behind the magic moments. [1] Face unlock on your phone. [2] Voice assistants like Siri and Alexa. [3] And self driving cars reading the road.

Then came generative AI. Instead of only recognising things, it creates brand new things. [1] Text. [2] Images. [3] Music. [4] Code. [5] Even voices. ChatGPT, Claude and Gemini are all generative AI. [6] Fun fact, the voice you are hearing right now was generated by AI, running on a laptop.

data.prompt: Write a birthday wish for my mom in 2 lines
data.reply: Happy birthday, Amma! Your love is my superpower, today and always.
data.funfact: This narration = AI voice, made locally

scenes.text: So here's the whole picture. [1] AI is the big circle. [2] Machine learning sits inside it. [3] Deep learning sits inside that. [4] And generative AI is the newest, innermost circle. [5] Every generative AI is AI. But not every AI is generative.

data.takeaway: Every GenAI is AI. Not every AI is GenAI.

scenes.text: Quick quiz! Your phone's face unlock. Which one is it? [1] Pause and think. <pause 3.2> [2] It's deep learning! It recognises your face. It doesn't create a new one, so it's not generative. Comment how many you got right!

scenes.text: Quick recap. [1] AI is the big idea. [2] Machine learning learns from data. [3] Deep learning uses neural networks. [4] Generative AI creates new content. [5] Next episode, what is a large language model, and how does ChatGPT actually think? Follow AI Maastaaru so you don't miss it!
